summary: Iteration 96: CRM v2 Workflow Automation Engine - Complete testing of backend workflow engine, notifications, quick create, and enhanced dashboard. Backend: 26/26 tests passed. Frontend: All new features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test workflows and entities created during backend tests (prefixed with TEST_) - auto-cleaned
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 96 adds real backend workflow automation engine replacing localStorage. Workflows now stored in MongoDB (crm2_workflows collection). Workflow execution creates tasks/activities/notifications in real collections. Quick Create endpoint works for contact/deal/case/task. Notifications system stores in crm2_notifications. Dashboard enhanced with Tasks Due, Stagnating Deals, Workflow Activity widgets. Sage 200 and Sicon integrations remain MOCKED.
